property_summary: C.transfer returns true (does not revert) whenever the recipient list is non-empty, even if inner token transfers fail.
Calling C.transfer never changes C's own Ether balance, regardless of inputs.
C.transfer reverts when the value array is shorter than the recipient array (index out of range), and otherwise returns true.
For any non-empty recipient list whose length equals the value list length, C.transfer never reverts and always returns true, regardless of the token or from addresses.
For any non-empty list of recipients, C.transfer never reverts and always returns true, even if the underlying token transferFrom calls fail.
When the recipient and value arrays are non-empty and equally sized, C.transfer returns true and leaves C's Ether balance unchanged.
C.transfer silently ignores failing token calls (e.g. to an address with no transferFrom) and still returns true without moving any Ether.
C.transfer always reverts when the recipient array is empty, regardless of other inputs.
For any non-empty recipient array with matching length-2 arrays of two recipients, C.transfer returns true and does not revert, regardless of the token address.
C.transfer always returns true, even when the underlying token call fails, for any non-empty recipient list.
